desc: Implement helper `is_possible(limit)` that computes minimum flips needed so no run exceeds `limit`: single pass over s, for each maximal run of length L add `L // (limit + 1)` to total; return total <= numOps.
Implement binary search over k in [1, n]: if `is_possible(mid)` search left (record mid), else search right; return the smallest feasible k.
Verify solution against examples: "000001"/1 → 2, "0000"/2 → 1, "0101"/0 → 1; also sanity-check edge cases numOps=0 (longest existing run) and large numOps (answer 1).
